title: CHO-Bench: How Do Context Hints Affect Ad Rankings in LLM Advertising?
summary: Innovation: Drawing on established marketing frameworks, we develop seven context hint generation strategies covering What, Who, and When, along with a Unified strategy that combines all seven dimensions. Why it matters: ad ranking decides which ads win impressions; better ordering lifts CTR and revenue per session.

title: What Matters for LLM Persona Simulation: Signal Form in Cold-Start E-Commerce Advertising
summary: Innovation: Estimating advertising performance in cold-start settings is challenging because historical logs are unavailable before launch. Why it matters: shows how LLMs can be used inside ads ranking/targeting rather than only in content recsys.

title: X-split Argus: Learning Reusable History Tokens for Efficient CTR Prediction
summary: Innovation: We present X-split ARGUS, a framework for ad ranking whose history compressor and online ranker are trained end to end. Why it matters: ad ranking decides which ads win impressions; better ordering lifts CTR and revenue per session.

title: Improving Ads Ranking Models with Auxiliary Supervision: Techniques and Insights
summary: Innovation: We detail architectural innovations such as linearized labels for improved auxiliary signal precision, a split architecture to facilitate training task decomposition, and a novel Label Combination… Why it matters: ad ranking decides which ads win impressions; better ordering lifts CTR and revenue per session.

title: Towards Reliable, Scalable, and Value-Aligned Generative Recommendation for Large-Scale Advertising
summary: Innovation: We present GR4AD-X, which addresses these limitations through reliable SID construction, serving-efficient capacity scaling, and unified value alignment. Why it matters: generating ad candidates directly could simplify the ads retrieval stack and improve recall.

title: AdSteer: Native Advertising in Large Language Model Generation
summary: Innovation: We propose AdSteer, a lightweight decoding-time advertising framework that adaptively adjusts token probabilities to integrate contextually appropriate advertisement into responses. Why it matters: shows how LLMs can be used inside ads ranking/targeting rather than only in content recsys.

title: Numerical Embeddings for CTR Prediction: A Taxonomy, Unified Benchmark, and Open-Source FuxiCTR Extension
summary: Innovation: Numerical embeddings map scalar features into vectors before a click-through rate (CTR) backbone combines the fields. Why it matters: more accurate CTR/CVR estimates feed ranking, bidding, and budget pacing in the ads auction.

title: KARMA: Training-Free Knowledge-Atomic Harness Evolution for Industrial Advertising Agents
summary: Innovation: We present KARMA (Knowledge-Atomic, Regression-Gated Modular Adaptation), a training-free framework that evolves six typed knowledge modules while keeping model weights and executable harness code… Why it matters: relevant to how candidates are retrieved, ranked, and served to users.

title: Slim Foundation Models for Latency-Critical Recommendation Serving
summary: Innovation: We propose a resource-efficient pipeline, SlimFM, that makes online LLM-based semantic modeling practical: (1) dependency-aware structured pruning compresses LLaMA3-8B by 44% to a 4.5B-parameter… Why it matters: a shared ads foundation model could serve targeting, ranking, and creative from one backbone.

title: Budget, Readout or Reasoning? Where Small Reasoning Models Lose Value in Auction Bidding
summary: Innovation: Ad platforms and marketplaces show bidders a bid landscape, the estimated chance of winning at each candidate bid, and increasingly let agents built on reasoning language models choose the bid. Why it matters: relevant to how candidates are retrieved, ranked, and served to users.
